stem.text: The graph shows the antibody concentration in blood following vaccination and a booster vaccination 28 days later.

stem.alt: Graph of antibody concentration against time in days, showing a primary response after vaccination, a booster vaccination at day 28 and a secondary response, with labelled arrows and curves.

stem.text: Which statements about the changes in antibody concentration are correct?

items: Antibody concentration falls after the primary response because antibodies are broken down and are no longer being produced.
The secondary response is more rapid due to memory B cells produced from activated B cells in the primary response.
The secondary response lasts longer than the primary response because memory B cells live longer than plasma B cells.
